thread.title: Apple: Fiscal 4Q Earnings Snapshot

author: Associated Press
title: Apple: Fiscal 4Q Earnings Snapshot
text:
CUPERTINO, Calif. (AP) _ Apple Inc. (AAPL) on Thursday reported fiscal fourth-quarter earnings of $14.13 billion.
On a per-share basis, the Cupertino, California-based company said it had net income of $2.91.
The results surpassed Wall Street expectations. The average estimate of 12 analysts surveyed by Zacks Investment Research was for earnings of $2.79 per share.
The maker of iPhones, iPads and other products posted revenue of $62.9 billion in the period, which also topped Street forecasts. Ten analysts surveyed by Zacks expected $61.49 billion.
For the current quarter ending in January, Apple said it expects revenue in the range of $89 billion to $93 billion. Analysts surveyed by Zacks had expected revenue of $91.32 billion.
Apple shares have climbed 31 percent since the beginning of the year, while the Standard & Poor's 500 index has increased 2 percent. In the final minutes of trading on Thursday, shares hit $222.22, a rise of 33 percent in the last 12 months.
